scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'if [ "$SKIP_PNPM_CHECK" = "1" ] || [ "$CI" = "true" ]; then exit 0; fi; rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.ci: sh -c 'set +e; if pnpm install --frozen-lockfile; then pnpm -r --if-present run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build; else echo pnpm install failed, approving builds and retrying; pnpm approve-builds --all || true; pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm -r --if-present run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build; fi'
scripts.release: pnpm run build && pnpm run wasm:build
scripts.package:zip: sh -c 'rm -f release-artifacts.zip || true; zip -r release-artifacts.zip artifacts/chess-game/dist artifacts/chess-game/src/chess-wasm 2>/dev/null || true'
